changes.title: Deaths, births and migration by county first published
changes.summary: Census Bureau estimates of deaths, births, international and domestic migration and residents aged 65, 75 and 85 or older for every county, Vintage 2025: in the year to July 1, 2025 the United States recorded 3,101,603 deaths and 3,620,461 births, and 7,041,036 residents were 85 or older.
